transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess I’m here because I feel… wound up most of the time. Like my body’s always bracing for something bad, even when I’m just sitting at my desk or trying to enjoy dance night.
Do you find that this feeling of being wound up happens more in social situations, like when you're around other people or in public settings?
Not really just social situations. It’s kind of… most of the time. Like even at my desk, or when I’m supposed to be having fun at dance night, my body still feels braced for something.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports feeling 'wound up' most of the time, not limited to social situations or specific triggers, which aligns more closely with F41.1 Generalized Anxiety Disorder.
